title: Embedded hire landing pad — 30-day activation playbook (v2)
body:
Purpose:
A compact, pragmatic playbook to accelerate an embedded hire (product/engineering/solutions engineer embed) to useful independence in 30 days. Designed for fast-moving squads that need a temporary full-time embedded resource for early-stage product work or pilot integrations. This is intentionally light, role-agnostic, and focused on execution velocity + evidence-driven handoff.

Scope and assumptions:
- Target: mid-level IC (L3-L4 equivalent) joining as an embedded contributor for a 1–3 month pilot.
- Not a replacement for full onboarding matrix; this sits on top of standard People Ops baseline (IT, payroll, compliance).
- Emphasis on outcome-oriented ramp (deliver one small feature / integration / customer POC in 30 days).

Quick TL;DR checklist (one-line actions):
- Day -2: Slack intro, calendar invites for 30d kickoff, confirm laptop + access.
- Day 0: Mentor assigned, read-ahead links sent, small repo clone + local start verified.
- Day 1: Orientation + 2-hour product deep-dive + acceptance criteria for month goal.
- Week 1: Complete two small tickets, pair with mentor on PR, join squad rituals.
- Week 2: Start primary deliverable, weekly sync with host manager + People Ops check-in.
- Week 3: Demo alpha to squad, incorporate feedback, start handoff doc.
- Week 4: Final demo, handoff checklist, capture lessons and next steps.

Day-by-day snapshot (practical items):
Day -2 to 0 (pre-landing)
- People Ops sends: IT checklist, VPN + KMS access request forms, required trainings list.
- Host manager posts a 1-paragraph role snapshot in #hiring-embeds and pings mentor.
- Read-ahead packet (1 pager): objectives, success metrics, three key repos, product doc link.

Day 1 (kickoff)
- 09:00: 30m welcome / expectations with host manager (doc: acceptance_criteria.md).
- 10:00: 2h product/context walkthrough (PM + tech lead). Focus on problem, users, and why this pilot matters.
- 14:00: Pair setup with mentor: local dev environment verified, run-tests passing.
- To do: create a small first-PR task (e.g., add telemetry to an existing endpoint).

Week 1 (obvious wins)
- Goal: ship 1–2 small PRs and join standups + retro.
- Shadow customer call (if applicable) or read three customer incident summaries.
- People Ops: 15-min check-in re role alignment + benefits questions.

Week 2 (ownership)
- Start primary ticket/POC: define acceptance criteria with stakeholder.
- Weekly sync: 30m with host manager, 30m with mentor.
- Midpoint: demo lightweight prototype in squad demo.

Week 3 (iterate)
- Harden alpha, add tests, address performance edge cases.
- Begin handoff doc: runbook, sequences, and known limitations.
- Conduct cross-team review for security/compliance if needed.

Week 4 (ship + handoff)
- Final demo to stakeholders and record video (5–8 min).
- Complete 30-day evaluation form and a short retrospective (documented).
- Handoff: tag owner(s) for next 3 tasks and create follow-up tickets.

Success metrics (evidence we share)
- Technical: at least one merged PR tied to acceptance criteria, with coverage/tests and CI green.
- Product: demo recorded + written acceptance (PM sign-off).
- People: mentor completed 3 pairing sessions; host manager rates hire >= "meets expectations" on ramp form.
- Operational: all required access and trainings completed by day 5.

Interview rubric (for hire selection and later calibration)
- Problem decomposition (30%): can break ambiguous goals into 3 clear milestones. Look for clarity in trade-offs.
- Execution orientation (30%): history of shipping small scoped work quickly; evidence of PRs/bugs fixed.
- Collaboration (20%): communicates clearly, knows how to ask for help and give constructive feedback.
- Domain curiosity (10%): interest in user/customer context, asks at least 2 relevant follow-ups.
- Risk/ownership signals (10%): identifies risks, proposes mitigations, commits to follow-through.
Scoring: 1–5 per pillar, pass threshold >= 16/25 for embedded roles.

Onboarding checklist (expandable, copyable to new hire doc):
- Admin: payroll/profile, equipment shipped, badge + building access (if office).
- Security: VPN, SSO, 2FA, KMS roles requested, security training assigned.
- Repo access: at least read + pipeline token for CI, ability to create branches + PRs.
- Productivity: calendar blocks for mentor + weekly 1:1, standing squad rituals on calendar.
- Knowledge: read product one-pager, top 5 design docs, top 5 customer threads.
- Social: intro thread in #team, 30-min coffee with at least one cross-functional partner.

Templates + artifacts to attach (minimal must-haves)
- 30-day acceptance_criteria.md (one paragraph + 3 measurable checkpoints).
- Pairing log (sheet): dates, topics, blocker notes.
- Handoff runbook (template): how to run, backstop contact, known issues.
- Demo recording + 2-slide summary for execs.

Mentor playbook (quick notes for mentors)
- First 48h: make time to sit with hire for environment + first commit.
- Weekly: 1-hour guided pairing + 30-min ad-hoc for blockers.
- Emphasize small, reviewable PRs; teach writing concise acceptance criteria.
- Signal when hire is ready to own larger pieces (e.g., leads a demo).

Evaluation & handoff (end of 30 days)
- Host manager completes evaluation form (quant + qualitative).
- Hire writes a 1-page learning memo: what they shipped, why, and recommendations.
- Decide: extend embed, convert to permanent role, or hand back to rotation pool. Document decision + next steps in JIRA ticket.

Notes-to-self / known gaps (open questions)
- Need a shorter compliance checklist for external contractor embeds (legal asked for this).
- Consider a lightweight badge system to mark "embedding-ready" mentors.
- Can we automate sending read-ahead packet 5 days before start? (JIRA: PEOPLE-1728)

Quick links (useful)
- Confluence onboarding hub: https://confluence.internal/redwood/onboard-hub
- Read-ahead template: https://confluence.internal/redwood/templates/embedded-readahead
- JIRA template board: PEOPLE-ONBOARD-BOARD
- Slack channel: #hiring-embeds

Appendix: example 30-day acceptance_criteria.md (copyable)
- Objective: Ship searchable customer config endpoint for pilot integration.
- Success checkpoints:
  1) Day 10: Create prototype endpoint, end-to-end test, and basic docs.
  2) Day 20: Performance baseline established (p95 < 200ms in staging).
  3) Day 30: Feature merged, demo delivered, PM sign-off, three follow-up tickets created.

End notes: This is intentionally opinionated and minimal. Use as the "landing pad" when speed matters. Please add feedback directly in the doc or ping #hiring-embeds — we iterate fast.
